findings.issue: The replaced pin criterion is not checkable as written inside the built image. AC and Verification Steps rely on `apt-cache policy` run "в контейнере" to show origin and priorities (beta suite at 100, jammy-pgdg at 500, installed versions traced to jammy-pgdg). But testing/Dockerfile:32 ends the RUN layer with `rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*`, and the task explicitly mandates keeping that as the last step (What to do §1, Implementation hints). With no package indices, `apt-cache policy <pkg>` prints only Installed/Candidate plus a single `100 /var/lib/dpkg/status` line — no repo, no suite, no priority — and bare `apt-cache policy` prints no source list at all. The executor would see empty output and either re-run apt-get update unprompted or mark the criterion passed on no evidence, which is exactly the silent failure the criterion was rewritten to prevent. Secondary: the AC writes the check as `apt-cache policy postgresql-14..18 postgresql-plperl-14..18 postgresql-common`, which is not an executable form; only the Verification Steps spell the list out.
findings.fix: Name where the evidence is captured: either add a build-time step inside the same RUN before the cleanup (e.g. `apt-cache policy postgresql-14 ... postgresql-19 postgresql-common > /var/log/apt-policy-build.txt`, inspected after build), or state in the AC that the check requires `apt-get update` first in the running container. Also expand the `14..18` shorthand in the AC into the full package list.

findings.issue: The pin rationale in Implementation hints is mechanically wrong: "100 = «ниже, чем уже установленное», поэтому апгрейд существующих пакетов из этого источника не произойдёт". Installed versions get priority exactly 100 (from /var/lib/dpkg/status), not more; per apt_preferences(5) a version at 100 <= P < 500 IS installed when the installed version is older. What actually protects postgresql-14..18 / postgresql-common is that the stable jammy-pgdg source supplies those same packages at priority 500, which outranks the pinned beta suite. The conclusion holds for this image, but the stated mechanism would mislead diagnosis if the pin is ever misapplied (e.g. for a package present only in the beta suite).
findings.fix: Reword the hint: Pin-Priority 100 keeps the beta suite below the stable pgdg source (500), so every package also present in jammy-pgdg resolves from stable; postgresql-19 installs because it exists only in the beta suite. Explicit `-t <beta-suite>` stays correct and harmless.

findings.issue: Verification step 3's `-run` regex ('Test_Stat|Test_Common|Test_Overview|Test_collectOverviewStat|Test_SelectStatDatabaseGeneralQuery') does not cover two tests the task itself requires observing. `Test_QueryPgcenterSchema` (internal/query/pgcenter_schema_test.go:10) — the plperlu canary the TDD Anchor demands a PASS from, subtest `query-pgcenter-schema/190000` — matches none of the alternatives. `Test_ArchivingBacklogQuery_Degrades` (internal/query/overview_test.go:123, loop at :128) is one of the four consumers of `overviewVersions` that Group 1 site #10 names, and `Test_Overview` does not match it either. Everything else in the regex resolves correctly (Test_StatBgwriterQueries, Test_StatIOQueries, Test_StatIOTimeQueries, Test_StatWALQueries, Test_StatReplicationSlotsQueries*, Test_CommonQueries, Test_OverviewQueries*, Test_OverviewBgwriterColumns, Test_collectOverviewStat).
findings.fix: Add the two names to the regex (e.g. `Test_Stat|Test_Common|Test_Overview|Test_Archiving|Test_QueryPgcenterSchema|Test_collectOverviewStat|Test_SelectStatDatabaseGeneralQuery`), or drop `-run` and run the packages verbose, filtering the output on `190000`.

findings.issue: Step 9's tmux install fails as written. The task says `apt-get install -y tmux` inside the running container works because "the image already has the apt sources it needs" — that conflates sources.list entries (which do survive) with the package indices, which do not: testing/Dockerfile:32 removes /var/lib/apt/lists/* in the same RUN layer, so the published image carries no indices and the command aborts with `E: Unable to locate package tmux`. tmux is the driving mechanism for the whole 27-screen walk, so this blocks the manual half until the executor works it out.
findings.fix: Write the command as `apt-get update && apt-get install -y tmux` and drop the "already has the apt sources it needs" justification, or restate it as: the sources.list entries are present, the package indices are not.

findings.issue: Step 1's "`docker exec` the cluster bootstrap: `prepare-test-environment.sh`. Nothing exists before this step" overstates the starting state. The Debian/pgdg postgresql-N packages create the `N/main` clusters during image build (postgresql-common postinst), which is exactly why the script guards creation with `if ! pg_lsclusters | grep -q "^$v "` (testing/prepare-test-environment.sh:6-10). What the script actually supplies is the postgresql.auto.conf overlay (ports 21914-21919, ssl, wal_level, shared_preload_libraries), the pg_hba rewrite, cluster start, fixtures load and the readiness check. An executor who reads "nothing exists" and then sees six clusters in `pg_lsclusters` before running anything may suspect a broken image.
findings.fix: Reword to: the image ships unstarted, unconfigured `N/main` clusters from package install; the script configures ports and pg_hba, starts them and loads fixtures — nothing is reachable on 21914-21919 until it runs.

findings.issue: Step 6's description of the Decision 7 collateral — "с 21919 down they skip wholesale, for every version, not just for PG 19" — is imprecise about what executed. `190000` is appended at the tail of each list (Task 4 Group 1), so the `t.Skipf` fires only when the loop reaches the unreachable version and the PG 14-18 iterations have already run their assertions; only the reported status becomes SKIP (a genuine PG 14-18 failure would still surface as FAIL). Task 4's own edge-case note states this correctly ("will report SKIP as a whole ... *after* having asserted PG 14-18"). As written, step 6 can be read as "PG 14-18 coverage disappears", which is not what happens.
findings.fix: Match Task 4's wording: with 21919 down these nine tests report SKIP as a whole after having already asserted PG 14-18; what is lost is the reported verdict, not the earlier iterations.
